feat(pm): Add PMAlternative tool for automatic blocker handling

When PM agent encounters external blockers (network issues, download
failures, unavailable resources), it can now automatically try alternative
approaches instead of waiting for user intervention.

Key additions:
- AlternativeManager service for managing blocker detection and alternatives
- PMAlternative tool with actions: detect, init, next, mark_success/failed, report
- Updated PM agent instructions with blocker handling workflow
- Comprehensive unit and integration tests

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(daemon): Add background task execution system

Implement daemon process that executes LLM tasks in background,
surviving terminal/session disconnection.

Components:
- database.ts: SQLite storage for sessions/tasks (WAL mode)
- executor.ts: Runs query loop in daemon, stores output to buffer
- output-buffer.ts: Caches output chunks, supports replay on reconnect
- server.ts: IPC server with execute/get_output/cancel handlers
- client.ts: High-level API with streamOutput() async generator
- lifecycle.ts: Daemon start/stop/status management
- ipc.ts: Length-prefixed JSON protocol for IPC

Key features:
- Tasks continue running after client disconnects
- Output buffered for replay when client reconnects
- Cross-platform: Unix socket (Unix/macOS) or TCP (Windows)
- 63 tests covering all components

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(search): Add SQLite-based code search index system

Implement three-tier search acceleration for large codebases:
- Path indexing: Fast glob pattern matching (<10ms vs 500-1000ms)
- FTS5 full-text search: Fast content search with BM25 ranking
- Vector search: Semantic/natural language queries via embeddings

Key components:
- database.ts: SQLite connection with WAL mode and schema migrations
- gitignore-parser.ts: Full .gitignore syntax support
- path-indexer.ts: Incremental file path indexing by mtime
- content-indexer.ts: FTS5 virtual table for content search
- vector-indexer.ts: Embedding storage with cosine similarity
- embeddings/: Local (transformers.js) and OpenAI providers

Tool integration:
- Glob tool: Optional use_index parameter, transparent fallback
- Grep tool: Uses FTS5 for simple patterns, regex for complex
- SemanticSearch tool: New tool for natural language code queries

Index stored in .panpan/index.db with automatic incremental updates.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(services): Add PM service with requirement clarification and budget tracking

PM (Project Manager) SA implementation for automated requirement verification:

Services layer (src/services/pm/):
- RequirementsManager: Track requirement lifecycle and Q&A history
- ClarificationHelper: Detect vague terms and generate clarifying questions
- TestFinder: Locate existing test files in projects
- TestGenerator: Generate test templates for Deno/Jest/Vitest/Mocha
- BudgetTracker: Manage token/time/attempt limits with event notifications

Tools layer (src/tools/pm/):
- PMRequirement: Create, analyze, and track requirements
- PMTestPlan: Find existing tests or generate new templates
- PMBudget: Initialize and check budget status

PM SA configuration added to agent-loader.ts with strict workflow enforcement:
- Must clarify requirements before implementation
- Must verify tests pass before completion
- Budget exhaustion is the only valid reason to end without success

Includes 92 new tests covering all PM functionality.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(services): Add watcher service with resource monitoring

Implement module E of SA expansion - a plugin-based monitoring architecture
for system resources:

- BaseMonitor abstract class with getCommand()/parseOutput() pattern
- GPUMonitor: nvidia-smi based GPU utilization, memory, temperature
- CPUMonitor: /proc/stat based CPU usage and load average
- MemoryMonitor: /proc/meminfo based RAM and swap usage
- DiskMonitor: df based disk space and inode monitoring
- NetworkMonitor: /sys/class/net based network I/O throughput
- MonitorRegistry: singleton for registering and querying monitors
- AlertManager: threshold-based alerting with cooldown support

Includes 50 unit tests covering parsing logic, registry management,
and alert triggering.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(services): Add logger service with four-level logging system

Implement LoggerSA core service layer with observer pattern:

- Summarizer: Operation statistics, timeline generation
- Failure analyzer: Failure point detection, fix suggestions

Four-level logging hierarchy: summary → tool → llm → full
Errors and aborts are always recorded regardless of level.
